title: tricalysia javanica
intro: Tricalysia javanica, commonly known as Javanese tricalysia, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is a shrub native to Indonesia, known for its medicinal properties and various health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tricalysia javanica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
